name: Trade War Escalation
description: Escalating tariffs between major economies spiral into a full-blown trade war that disrupts global supply chains and threatens worldwide recession

phases.name: Tariff Shock
headlines: Government announces sweeping tariffs on imports — trade partners vow retaliation
Markets reel as surprise tariff announcement threatens global supply chains
Broad tariff package targets hundreds of billions in trade — escalation fears mount
phases.summary: A major economy announces aggressive new tariffs targeting key trading partners. The scope and severity exceed market expectations. Supply chain-dependent sectors sell off sharply as companies scramble to assess the impact on costs and revenues.

phases.name: Retaliatory Escalation
headlines: Trading partners announce retaliatory tariffs — tit-for-tat escalation begins
Agricultural exports targeted in retaliation; farm sector faces crisis
Global trade volume projections slashed as tariff war intensifies
phases.summary: Trading partners retaliate with their own tariffs, targeting politically sensitive industries. The escalation accelerates faster than diplomats can manage. Global trade volumes begin declining and multinational companies issue profit warnings.

phases.name: Trade Deal
headlines: Breakthrough in trade negotiations — framework deal reached at emergency summit
Markets surge on trade deal announcement; tariff rollback timeline agreed
Phase one trade agreement includes purchase commitments and tariff reductions
phases.summary: Diplomatic efforts produce a framework agreement. Both sides agree to reduce tariffs in phases and establish new trade rules. Markets rally on relief, though implementation details remain uncertain and full normalization will take time.

phases.name: Economic Cold War
headlines: Trade war hardens into economic cold war — technology transfer banned
Supply chain decoupling accelerates as companies forced to choose sides
Economic blocs form as trade war reshapes global commerce permanently
phases.summary: The trade war evolves into a prolonged economic cold war. Technology restrictions, investment bans, and forced supply chain decoupling create two competing economic spheres. Companies face enormous restructuring costs.

phases.name: Brinkmanship
headlines: Trade war escalates to financial warfare — currency manipulation accusations fly
Emergency tariffs expanded to cover virtually all imports between major economies
Military posturing accompanies economic threats — geopolitical risk premium surges
phases.summary: The conflict escalates beyond trade into financial warfare and military posturing. Currency manipulation, sanctions on financial institutions, and military movements in disputed territories raise the specter of actual conflict.

phases.name: Deal Implementation
headlines: Trade deal implementation progresses — tariffs reduced on schedule
Business confidence recovers as supply chain uncertainty fades
Markets reach new highs as trade normalization removes key risk
phases.summary: The trade deal is implemented on schedule. Tariffs come down, supply chains readjust, and business confidence recovers. Markets rally as the removal of trade uncertainty unlocks pent-up investment and spending.

phases.name: Bifurcated World
headlines: Global economy splits into competing blocs — reshoring costs hit corporate earnings
Supply chain restructuring drives inflation as cheap imports disappear
Markets adjust to permanently higher costs in bifurcated global economy
phases.summary: The world settles into two distinct economic spheres. Companies absorb massive restructuring costs, consumer prices rise, and economic growth slows. Markets adapt to a structurally different, less efficient global economy.

phases.name: Crisis De-escalation
headlines: Back-channel diplomacy pulls conflict from the brink — ceasefire in trade war
Emergency summit produces fragile truce — markets rally on relief
Military tensions ease but economic damage already severe
phases.summary: Last-minute diplomatic efforts pull both sides back from the brink. A fragile truce is established, but enormous economic damage has already been done. Markets rally on relief but remain haunted by the possibility of renewed conflict.

phases.name: New Trade Architecture
headlines: New international trade framework emerges from crisis — multilateral rules updated
Global commerce begins recovery under revised trade rules
Markets price in new trade reality — winners and losers from restructured supply chains
phases.summary: A new trade architecture emerges from the crisis. Whether through deal, cold war, or brinkmanship resolution, global commerce operates under fundamentally different rules. Markets adjust to the new landscape of winners and losers.

name: Geopolitical Crisis
description: A major geopolitical crisis erupts — military conflict, terror attack, or regional war sends shockwaves through global markets as oil spikes and safe havens surge

phases.name: Crisis Erupts
headlines: Breaking: Major geopolitical crisis erupts — markets in freefall, oil surges 20%
Military conflict in key region sends shockwaves through global markets
Safe-haven assets surge as geopolitical crisis threatens global stability
phases.summary: A major geopolitical crisis erupts without warning. Markets crash as investors flee to safety. Oil prices spike on supply disruption fears. Gold, treasuries, and the dollar surge as risk assets sell off across the board.

phases.name: Escalation and Fear
headlines: Military operations expand as diplomatic efforts stall — markets extend losses
Oil prices hit multi-year highs as conflict threatens key supply routes
Defense stocks surge as geopolitical risk premium embeds across all asset classes
phases.summary: The crisis escalates. Diplomatic efforts fail to produce results. Military operations expand, threatening critical energy supply routes. Markets continue falling as the geopolitical risk premium rises and economic forecasts are slashed.

phases.name: Quick Resolution
headlines: Ceasefire announced — diplomatic breakthrough de-escalates crisis
Markets rally sharply as geopolitical tensions ease rapidly
Oil retreats from crisis highs as supply disruption fears fade
phases.summary: A diplomatic breakthrough achieves a ceasefire. The speed of resolution surprises markets, triggering a sharp relief rally. Oil prices retreat and the risk premium begins to unwind, though lingering uncertainty keeps volatility elevated.

phases.name: Prolonged Conflict
headlines: Conflict enters protracted phase — markets adjust to sustained uncertainty
Energy prices remain elevated as prolonged disruption becomes baseline scenario
Global growth forecasts cut repeatedly as conflict drags on with no end in sight
phases.summary: The conflict settles into a prolonged stalemate. Markets gradually adapt to elevated risk premiums and higher energy prices. Economic growth slows as businesses and consumers adjust to a new reality of sustained geopolitical tension.

phases.name: Dangerous Escalation
headlines: Crisis escalates dramatically — additional nations drawn into conflict
Markets crash as escalation raises specter of wider regional war
Energy supply catastrophe: key infrastructure destroyed, oil hits record highs
phases.summary: The unthinkable happens — the conflict escalates further, drawing in additional actors. Critical energy infrastructure is damaged. Markets crash to new lows as the crisis threatens to spiral into a wider regional or global conflict.

phases.name: Peace Dividend
headlines: Peace agreement signed — reconstruction hopes drive market optimism
Oil normalizes as geopolitical risk premium fully unwinds
Markets reach pre-crisis levels as investors price in stability
phases.summary: A formal peace agreement brings lasting stability. Markets fully recover as the geopolitical risk premium unwinds. Oil prices normalize and economic forecasts are revised upward. Reconstruction efforts create new investment opportunities.

phases.name: Frozen Conflict
headlines: Conflict freezes with no resolution — markets learn to live with uncertainty
New military spending commitments strain government budgets globally
Defense and energy sectors outperform as conflict becomes structural feature
phases.summary: The conflict freezes into a permanent state of tension. Markets adapt to structurally higher defense spending, elevated energy prices, and ongoing uncertainty. The geopolitical landscape is permanently altered.

phases.name: Global Security Crisis
headlines: International coalition formed to contain escalation — massive military mobilization
Global recession triggered by energy crisis and security spending surge
Markets find floor as international intervention begins to stabilize situation
phases.summary: An international coalition intervenes to prevent further escalation. The massive military and humanitarian response strains government budgets and triggers recession fears. Markets eventually find a floor but remain deeply scarred.

name: Currency Crisis
description: A major currency collapses triggering capital flight, emerging market contagion, and fears of a global financial crisis reminiscent of 1997

phases.name: Currency Collapse
headlines: Major emerging market currency collapses 30% in days — central bank intervention fails
Capital flight accelerates as confidence in currency regime evaporates
Currency crisis erupts: reserves depleted, peg abandoned in emergency move
phases.summary: A major emerging market currency collapses after the central bank exhausts its reserves defending an unsustainable peg. Capital flight intensifies as domestic and foreign investors rush for the exits. The speed of the collapse catches markets off guard.

phases.name: Emerging Market Contagion
headlines: Currency crisis spreads — multiple emerging markets face pressure as contagion hits
Global banks reveal billions in emerging market exposure — credit concerns mount
Dollar-denominated debt crisis: EM corporates face impossible repayment burden
phases.summary: The crisis spreads to other vulnerable emerging markets. Investors pull capital indiscriminately from all developing economies. Global banks with significant EM exposure see their stocks fall as credit risk surges. Dollar-denominated debt becomes impossible to service.

phases.name: IMF Bailout
headlines: IMF announces emergency bailout package — largest in institution's history
Coordinated central bank action provides dollar swap lines to distressed economies
Bailout conditions include painful reforms but stem immediate crisis
phases.summary: The IMF steps in with a massive rescue package. Central banks coordinate dollar swap lines to ease the funding crisis. Bailout conditions require painful structural reforms, but the immediate panic subsides as a backstop is established.

phases.name: Sovereign Default Wave
headlines: First sovereign default triggers cascade — multiple nations unable to service debt
Global credit markets seize as default contagion spreads across emerging world
Banking crisis develops as EM loan portfolios implode
phases.summary: Without sufficient intervention, defaults cascade across multiple emerging markets. The global banking system faces massive write-downs on EM loans and bonds. Credit markets seize up as counterparty risk becomes impossible to assess.

phases.name: Global Contagion
headlines: EM crisis infects developed markets — European banks face liquidity crunch
Contagion breaches EM firewall: developed market credit spreads blow out
Global risk-off: crisis that started in emerging markets threatens world economy
phases.summary: The crisis breaks out of the emerging market sphere and hits developed economies. European and Japanese banks with heavy EM exposure face funding crises. The contagion becomes truly global, raising fears of a 2008-style systemic event.

phases.name: Stabilization and Reform
headlines: IMF program shows results — EM currencies stabilize and capital flows resume
Emerging market recovery gains traction as structural reforms take effect
Investor confidence returns to EM as crisis management proves effective
phases.summary: The IMF-led rescue works. Currencies stabilize, capital flows resume, and structural reforms begin to bear fruit. The crisis becomes a turning point for stronger institutions and more sustainable policies across emerging markets.

phases.name: Lost Decade
headlines: Emerging markets enter prolonged depression — years of growth wiped out
Default restructuring negotiations drag on — investor recoveries minimal
Generation of EM progress lost as crisis scars run deep
phases.summary: The wave of defaults leads to prolonged economic depression across emerging markets. Years of economic progress are wiped out. Restructuring negotiations drag on and investors face massive losses. The scars last for a generation.

phases.name: Coordinated Global Response
headlines: G20 emergency summit produces coordinated response to global crisis
Central banks worldwide cut rates and launch QE to fight contagion
Massive coordinated intervention stabilizes global markets — but at enormous cost
phases.summary: The global nature of the contagion forces an unprecedented coordinated response. G20 nations agree on joint stimulus, central banks cut rates simultaneously, and emergency lending facilities are expanded. Markets stabilize but at enormous fiscal cost.

phases.name: New Financial Architecture
headlines: International monetary reform: new frameworks to prevent future currency crises
Emerging markets embrace new reserve currency arrangements
Post-crisis financial system emerges with stronger emerging market safeguards
phases.summary: The crisis catalyzes reforms to the international monetary system. New reserve arrangements, stronger IMF capacity, and better early warning systems are implemented. The global financial architecture is fundamentally reshaped.

name: Sovereign Default
description: A major economy misses a bond payment, triggering a sovereign debt crisis that sends shockwaves through global bond markets and threatens the banking system

phases.name: Missed Payment
headlines: Sovereign default: major economy misses bond payment for first time in history
Bond markets in turmoil as sovereign credit event triggers CDS payouts
Government bonds of defaulting nation collapse to pennies on the dollar
phases.summary: A major economy fails to make a scheduled bond payment. The default triggers credit default swap payouts worth hundreds of billions. Bond markets convulse as investors reassess sovereign risk globally. The event is compared to the unthinkable.

phases.name: CDS and Bank Exposure
headlines: CDS spreads explode globally — investors dump bonds of vulnerable nations
Major banks reveal massive exposure to defaulting sovereign — writedown fears mount
Bond vigilantes attack: yields on peripheral sovereigns surge to unsustainable levels
phases.summary: The default sends shockwaves through the CDS market. Banks with heavy exposure to the defaulting sovereign face enormous writedowns. Bond vigilantes turn their attention to other vulnerable nations, driving their borrowing costs to crisis levels.

phases.name: Debt Restructuring
headlines: Creditor negotiations begin — orderly debt restructuring framework proposed
International community backs restructuring plan with transition financing
Markets stabilize as restructuring provides path forward for defaulting nation
phases.summary: An orderly restructuring process begins. Creditors agree to take haircuts in exchange for new bonds with extended maturities. International financial institutions provide bridge financing. The process is painful but managed.

phases.name: Default Cascade
headlines: Second sovereign default in weeks — cascade fears become reality
Global bond market in crisis as multiple nations lose market access
Banking system faces existential threat from sovereign debt write-downs
phases.summary: The initial default triggers a cascade. Investors flee sovereign debt of vulnerable nations, driving yields to levels that make refinancing impossible. Additional defaults follow. The global banking system faces an existential threat from write-downs.

phases.name: Political Revolution
headlines: Government falls as default triggers political crisis — new leadership repudiates debt
Populist government takes power, rejects austerity — confrontation with creditors
Markets plunge as political instability compounds sovereign default
phases.summary: The default triggers a political revolution. The incumbent government falls and is replaced by populist leadership that repudiates the debt entirely and rejects international conditions. The confrontation with creditors adds a political dimension to the financial crisis.

phases.name: Managed Recovery
headlines: Restructuring complete — new bonds trade at 60 cents on dollar, improving steadily
Defaulting nation regains market access after implementing reforms
Financial sector absorbs losses; markets recover as crisis contained
phases.summary: The restructuring is completed. Banks absorb their losses, the defaulting nation begins its recovery under new fiscal rules, and markets stabilize. The crisis serves as a wake-up call for fiscal discipline globally.

phases.name: Systemic Banking Crisis
headlines: Multiple major banks require emergency recapitalization after sovereign losses
Government forced to bail out banking system — irony of sovereign default causing bank bailout
Global financial system on life support as sovereign-bank doom loop plays out
phases.summary: The cascade of sovereign defaults causes a systemic banking crisis. Banks that were considered safe crumble under the weight of sovereign bond losses. Governments that didn't default are forced to bail out their banking systems, straining their own finances.

phases.name: Diplomatic Standoff
headlines: Populist government freezes foreign assets — international standoff escalates
Trade sanctions imposed on defaulting nation — economic isolation deepens
Protracted negotiations as political ideology clashes with economic reality
phases.summary: The political confrontation deepens into a diplomatic standoff. Asset freezes, sanctions, and trade restrictions isolate the defaulting nation. Eventually economic reality forces a pragmatic compromise, but the process is slow and damaging.

phases.name: Post-Crisis Reckoning
headlines: New sovereign debt frameworks established to prevent future default cascades
Global bond market permanently reprices sovereign risk — no more 'risk-free' assumption
Markets begin long recovery as new fiscal rules and debt sustainability frameworks emerge
phases.summary: The sovereign default crisis reshapes how markets think about government debt. The concept of 'risk-free' sovereign bonds is permanently challenged. New frameworks for debt sustainability, restructuring, and crisis prevention are established.
